transcript.msg: What made you decide to approve onboarding here, and what would have changed your mind?
A low-risk individual we've known for years. Nothing flags it, so I approve.
If the entity type were "trust" instead of individual, what would you decide?
For a company or a trust, I look at the largest owner. For an individual, the owner threshold doesn't apply.
What led you to request documents here, and what would have changed your mind?
No source of funds at 85,000 a month. Above 50,000 a month without a source of funds, I request documents.
If the entity type were "individual" instead of company, with the largest beneficial owner share at 100%, what would you...
If the largest owner holds more than 25% and isn't verified, it goes to enhanced review.
What led you to send this one to enhanced review, and what would have changed your mind?
Adverse media in a medium-risk country sends it to enhanced review.
